text:
After dinner, the evening shift read your comments with care and saw that your companion animal was not handled with the calm, coordinated service you were promised, and that the disruption affected your confidence in Aurelia Skyways. We understand the urgency of this matter and we are treating it as a service failure that deserves a direct reply.

The Companion Animal Travel Desk coordinates care from booking through pickup, and that chain depends on steady handoffs between check-in, the ground team, cabin staff, and arrival support. In your case, our review shows that the carrier was not moved with the level of attention expected, and that the transfer sequence left too much uncertainty at a point when clear communication mattered most. We are sorry for the stress this caused.

We have already asked the responsible teams to review the handling steps that were taken, with special focus on the moments before departure and the handoff to the ground team. The carrier must be treated as a priority item at every stage, and the staff involved are being reminded that quiet movement, clear labeling, and direct status updates are part of routine care, not extra service. We are also checking whether the service notes were read in full and whether the arrival team received the correct information for pickup.

Please know that this desk is keeping a record of your complaint and using it to reinforce procedure across the route. If you travel with us again, we want the next experience to reflect the standard you should have received from the start. Our team remains available to help with follow-up details and to make sure the file is fully tracked until the matter is resolved.

We regret the distress this caused and are acting now to prevent a repeat. Companion Animal Travel Desk
